business_problem: The lending industry has undergone a revolutionary transformation in Korea, thanks to rapid advancements in analytics and automation. Through improved risk management, faster underwriting times and easier credit access, this transformation has significantly impacted the Korean economy.
solution_summary: Finda built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform. The lending industry has undergone a revolutionary transformation in Korea, thanks to rapid advancements in analytics and automation. Through improved risk management, faster underwriting times and easier credit access, this transformation has significantly impacted the Korean economy. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. With Databricks Data + AI Platform, Finda can now process loans faster and help customers make more-informed business decisions.
